name: Smith Machine Seated Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench facing the low bar and rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists just past your knees.
Take a shoulder-width underhand grip and release the hooks without lifting your forearms.
Let the bar lower smoothly by extending your wrists toward the floor, then flex your wrists upward to curl the bar as high as possible.
Lower the bar back under control to full wrist extension and rerack securely when finished.
tips: Keep your forearms pressed against your thighs so your arms do not lift the bar upward.
Move through a slow, complete wrist range rather than bouncing the weight.
